scope_qualifier: Only the four recorded targeted indexed queries, their primary-source candidates, and the exact pinned local mathlib source scope were searched. This is not a claim of global nonexistence.

target.mathematical_shape: For positive level N, an actual nonzero cuspidal hyperbolic-Laplacian eigenfunction on the congruence quotient Gamma0(N)\H, with the native self-adjoint domain and genuine eigenvalue lambda, satisfies 975/4096 <= lambda.
target.parameter_shape: For exceptional lambda<1/4, the standard small spectral parameter has absolute value <=7/64; the repository doubled parameter tau=2*sqrt(max(1/4-lambda,0)) then has tau<=7/32. A claim about K-order real part must first identify its convention with this doubled parameter.
excluded_shortcuts: Arbitrary real lambda or arbitrary measure with an assumed lower bound
A spectral parameter defined identically zero
A theorem taking the desired Kim-Sarnak inequality as a hypothesis
A threshold restriction that deletes below-cap spectrum by definition
Free-cylinder KL/Hardy bounds substituted for an automorphic congruence gap

mathematical_vs_formal.mathematical_status: The requested bound is the known Kim-Sarnak congruence/automorphic spectral estimate, not a new conjecture to be disproved by this scout.

candidate_declarations.name: RHKimSarnakDescent.KimSarnak.kim_sarnak_squarefree_scaffold
candidate_declarations.shape: Takes LambdaToNu_mt_OPEN and NuBound_mt_OPEN plus Squarefree N, and concludes 975/4096 <= 1/4 - spectral_parameter_mt N^2.
candidate_declarations.actual_model: spectral_parameter_mt is the constant-zero map; LambdaToNu_mt_OPEN is reflexivity, and NuBound_mt_OPEN is an explicit cap assumption on that model.
candidate_declarations.rejection: No Gamma0 quotient, cuspidal space, Laplacian eigenfunction or actual eigenvalue is bound to this parameter.
candidate_declarations.verification: No compilation or axiom audit performed. Semantic mismatch alone rejects this as the required supplier.

candidate_declarations.name: TheoremaAureum.KimSarnak.kim_sarnak_squarefree_scaffold
candidate_declarations.shape: Conditional combinator: a lambda-to-parameter identity AND the assumed absolute parameter cap imply the numerical lower bound.
candidate_declarations.rejection: The exact needed analytic cap is NuBound_mt_OPEN, an explicit theorem argument; only its arithmetic consequence is proved.
candidate_declarations.verification: Source comments advertise a small axiom footprint for the conditional theorem, not a discharged Kim-Sarnak theorem. No trust claim was accepted without checking semantic premises.

candidate_declarations.name: ArakelovRH.lambda_1_pos_143

candidate_declarations.verification: Named OPEN proposition is visible in actual source. A no-sorry combinator cannot discharge its hypothesis.

repo_inputs.concrete_inputs: PacketData P with positive Y0/support region and arbitrary real order map t : iota -> Nat -> Nat -> Real. The adapter substitutes the actual imaginary-order K/q kernel and proves reconstruction plus an absolute coefficient-mass interchange budget.
repo_inputs.missing: No Gamma0 eigenvalue family, eigenfunction normalization, Kim-Sarnak cap or link from an automorphic spectral parameter to this arbitrary order map. This adapter alone does not supply Kuznetsov normalization, exceptional branch or spectral saving.

repo_inputs.concrete_missing_input: For the ACTUAL automorphic spectral measure mu: almost every lambda under exceptionalParameterMeasure mu satisfies 975/4096 <= lambda.
repo_inputs.why_not_supplied: mu is arbitrary; the cap theorem takes hlower explicitly. thresholdExceptionalTauMeasure instead restricts away all lower eigenvalues by definition, which does not prove that the original measure has no such mass.

repo_inputs.concrete_input: The conditional real inequality lambda>=975/4096 supplies tau<=7/32; it does not prove an automorphic spectral gap.

scope_cautions: Constant functions at eigenvalue zero must be excluded by the actual cuspidal/orthogonality model; applying the cap to arbitrary nonnegative spectra is false.
For lambda>=1/4 the max-based tau is zero; exceptional 0<=lambda<1/4 remains possible and requires the congruence gap input.
The arbitrary local exceptional restriction includes lambda=0; its pushforward support statement (0,1] does not itself impose the 7/32 cap.
The standard 7/64 spectral parameter and repository doubled 7/32 parameter must not be identified without the factor-two normalization theorem.
Even a reliable standalone cap would still need actual automorphic-measure and K-kernel normalization bindings; the current packet adapter is an absolute kernel budget.
